participation.context: Read the first line, left it, and kept the paper crown beside the part.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You looked at the opening line and did not improve it. You put the paper crown where you would take it up.

title: Left the first line as it stood

participation.context: Owned Kemp's thirteen, reported the yard rather than his intention, and accepted the morning at the Theatre.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Counted thirteen lines, said the yard had laughed at his, and refused the compliment of a song.
participation.name: Will Kemp

participation.context: Called the hush no accident, asked about the ending, and pointed with his thumb.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Added eleven and thirteen into twenty-four, and brought word of ten of the clock at the Theatre.
participation.name: Abel Garnish

participation.context: Gave the house as two-thirds of Thursday's, and louder, and would not name a sum.
participation.name: Goodwife Margery Pell

relations.note: the two days stand at twenty-four lines, with no song
relations.quote: Twenty-four in two days. At this rate he will owe us a scene by Easter.

story.body: You took twenty-four as the tally and refused a song. You told Burbage what the yard did. You let a thumb answer the lawyer. You took ten of the clock at the Theatre as the morning.

relations.note: the two days stand at twenty-four lines, with no song
relations.quote: Twenty-four in two days. At this rate he will owe us a scene by Easter.

title: Heard twenty-four lines and told Burbage what the yard did
